_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the export-control blocked-jurisdiction list (CZID-322). The authoritative, versioned list is owned by the compliance office / counsel -- engineering only wires it. This ONE file is consumed by the Layer-1 WAF geo rule (Terraform, via jsondecode(file(...))), the Layer-2 edge Lambda (bundled by build.sh and read at load), and the account-screening layer (seqtoid-web, vendored copy guarded by the blocked-jurisdictions-parity CI job). 'blocked_country_codes' is the enforced authority; 'rationale' annotates it; 'staged_for_counsel' are candidates NOT yet enforced. Change the enforced set HERE only, then re-plan the WAF + rebuild the Lambda + sync the seqtoid-web copy + re-run the CZID-333 harness. Governance: EXPORT-CONTROL-LIST-GOVERNANCE.md. Validate before commit: tools/validate-blocked-jurisdictions.py.

UA.note: Ratified 2026-08-20. WAF geo-match is country-granular, so this blocks ALL of Ukraine; sub-national region precision is handled by Layer 2 (CZID-327). The whole-country over-block is ratified.

RU.note: Ratified 2026-08-20. All-Russia over-block accepted; carries known business impact.

BY.note: Belarus -- candidate; awaiting counsel decision. NOT enforced.

VE.note: Venezuela -- candidate; awaiting counsel decision. NOT enforced.

MM.note: Myanmar/Burma -- candidate; awaiting counsel decision. NOT enforced.
